title: Terms of Use
description: Review the starter terms governing use of CounterCrave content and external links.
summary: CounterCrave provides general editorial information, not professional, electrical, medical or legal advice.

sections.heading: Informational purpose
paragraphs: Content is provided for general information and buying research. Readers should follow current manufacturer instructions and applicable safety guidance.
Product specifications, availability and external pages can change after publication.

sections.heading: External websites
paragraphs: CounterCrave may link to Amazon and other websites. Those websites operate under their own terms, privacy policies, prices, availability and customer-service processes.

sections.heading: Before production launch
paragraphs: These starter terms should be reviewed and replaced or approved by a qualified professional for the final business and jurisdiction.

faqs.question: What matters most when buying CounterCrave terms?
faqs.answer: Capacity, footprint, and cleanup. Confirm dimensions and accessories on the Amazon listing because bundles can change by seller.

faqs.question: Does CounterCrave show live prices?
faqs.answer: No. We link to Amazon so you can check current pricing, shipping, and stock with our disclosed Associates tags.

faqs.question: How often are pages updated?
faqs.answer: Priority commercial pages are refreshed when ASINs change, models retire, or a clearer fit appears for the same use case.
